blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a 4.51 × \times speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.
blocks.zh: 自动递归(AR)地基模型将空间预测序列化,引入顺序延时,并对输出符施加因果顺序. 我们视地面为视觉证据提取:物体,位置和空间关系共同受到图像和查询的限制,然而它们的依赖性并不意味着内在的左右生成顺序. 这种区分使得双向传播是一种自然的适合性,使得空间假说可以平行出现,并通过迭代解析来共同完善. 我们引入了Ground Anything,一种4B参数的地基模型,通过区块解析调和快速平行解码和精确本地化. 培训将公共数据集和专用数据引擎的地面预训、直接AR-向扩散转换与AR和传播联合目标、监督微调和基于GRPO的强化培训相结合。 在30个基准中,我们的自动递减变体GroundAnything-VLM在类似大小的模型中确立了新的总体技术水平,为72.42%,与GPT-6 Astra(71.35%)保持竞争力。 有了Entropy制导的解码,Ground Anything也超过了这个尺度上之前的状态,对于快速基于MTP的Lace Anything模型,平均为61.75%,而53.32%. 我们进一步探索解码策略,显示一种可选的自猜模式可以实现4.51×\时速比AR对应方快,COCO F1mIOU下降0.74个百分点. 基础设施实验显示,渐进推论优化将并行解码转化为实际加速. 这些支持在对耐久性敏感的现实世界系统中高效的视觉定位。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual grounding turns visual inputs into structured spatial predictions across object detection, referring expression comprehension, OCR, GUI interaction, and embodied perception. Next-token prediction has become a mainstream paradigm for generative grounding, with models such as Pix2Seq, Florence-2, and Rex-Omni expressing visual predictions as structured token sequences ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) . However, autoregressive (AR) decoding serializes labels and coordinates, introducing sequential latency and restricting output interactions to the generated prefix ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . These limitations are particularly costly in dense scenes and complex layouts.
blocks.zh: 视觉地面将视觉输入转化为结构化的空间预测,跨越物体探测,转引表达理解,OCR,GUI相互作用,并包含感知. 接下来的托肯预测已经成为基因定位的主流范式,Pix2Seq,Florence-2,Rex-Omni等模型将视觉预测表达为结构化的符号序列(Jiang等人,2026年;Chen等人,2022年;Xiao等人,2024年). 然而,自动递归(AR)解码序列标签和坐标,引入顺序延缓,并将输出相互作用限制在生成的前缀(Chen等人,2022年;Cheng等人,2024年). 在密集的场景和复杂的布局中,这些限制特别昂贵.

blocks.en: To reduce AR decoding latency, LocateAnything uses multi-token prediction (MTP) for parallel box decoding ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Diffusion VLMs support parallel generation and bidirectional refinement, with advances in multimodal understanding ( You et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026a ) , GUI grounding ( Kumbhar et al., 2026 ) , and document OCR ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . Yet these grounding applications remain domain-specific, leaving diffusion’s broader potential for unified structured prediction across diverse visual tasks largely untapped.
blocks.zh: 为了降低AR解码率,Location Anything使用多键预测(MTP)进行平行箱解码(Wang等人,2026年). 扩散的VLM支持平行生成和双向改进,在多式联运(You等人, 2026b;Wu等人, 2026a),GUI定位(Kumbhar等人, 2026),以及文件OCR(Dong等人, 2026)方面取得进展。 然而,这些基础应用仍然针对具体领域,使传播在各种视觉任务中实现统一结构预测的更广泛潜力基本上未开发。

blocks.en: To unlock this potential and reconcile fast parallel decoding with broad and precise visual grounding, we start from a familiar observation: we may notice objects or read separate signs in different orders, yet reach the same judgment about what is present and where. We therefore view grounding as structured visual evidence extraction: spatial variables are jointly constrained by the image and query, without an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. Bidirectional masked diffusion naturally supports this process, allowing hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be refined using shared visual evidence and partially recovered structure ( ).
blocks.zh: 为了解开这一潜力,并调和快速平行的解码与广泛而精确的视觉地面,我们从一个熟悉的观察开始:我们可能以不同的顺序注意到物体或读取单独的标志,但对现在和地点却作出同样的判断. 因此,我们认为地面是结构化的视觉证据提取:空间变量共同受到图像和查询的制约,没有内在的左到右生成顺序. 双向遮盖扩散自然支持这个过程,允许假说平行出现,并利用共享的视觉证据和部分回收的结构加以完善(.

blocks.en: We introduce GroundAnything , a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model combining broad perceptual capabilities with blockwise parallel decoding. A shared vocabulary with quantized coordinates unifies diverse grounding tasks. Its decoder combines bidirectional attention within blocks with causal dependencies across blocks, enabling parallel prediction and KV-cache reuse ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Ground Anything,一种4B参数的地基模型,结合了广义的知觉能力与块形平行解码. 使用量化坐标的共用词汇统一了各种地面任务。 其编解码器将区块内的双向注意力和跨区块的因果依赖性结合起来,使平行预测和KV-cache再利用成为可能(Arriola等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Grounding pretraining draws on public datasets and dedicated data engines. We build GroundAnything-VLM and GroundAnything from a shared pretrained checkpoint, applying AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives to the latter. Both variants then undergo supervised fine-tuning and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training.
blocks.zh: 地面预训借鉴了公共数据集和专用数据引擎. 我们从一个经过事先培训的共用检查站建立地面-甚高压材料和地面-任何材料,对后者实行AR-向扩散转换,并有共同的AR和传播目标。 两个变种随后都经过监督的微调和基于GPRO的加固后训练.

blocks.en: Across 30 grounding benchmarks, GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything is, to our knowledge, the first diffusion language model to surpass the prior overall AR state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% at over 2 × \times the speed of GroundAnything-VLM. We use this mode throughout the main benchmarks to evaluate pure diffusion decoding without AR verification. Additional ablations examine key model and training design choices.
blocks.zh: 在30个基准中,GroundAnything-VLM在类似大小的模型中确立了新的总体技术水平,为72.42%,与GPT-6 Astra(71.35%)保持竞争力。 根据我们的知识,通过Entropy制导的解码,Ground Anything是第一个在这个尺度上超过之前总体AR状态的传播语言模型,平均为61.75%,超过2×xx%时的Ground Anything-VLM速度. 我们在整个主要基准中都使用这一模式,在没有AR核查的情况下评估纯扩散解码。 此外,还审查了关键模式和培训设计选择。

blocks.en: We further conduct a systematic speed analysis of decoding strategies and their trade-offs, including comparisons with MTP-based generation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . An optional self-speculative mode combines diffusion drafting with AR verification and improves both speed and accuracy over entropy-guided decoding on COCO, achieving a 4.51 × \times speedup over GroundAnything-VLM with only a 0.74 pp F1mIoU drop. Systematic infrastructure experiments with SGLang, CUDA Graph, and FP8 demonstrate further practical speedups through progressive inference optimizations, supporting efficient visual grounding in real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步系统分析解码策略及其权衡,包括与基于中期计划的一代进行比较(Wang等人,2026年)。 一种可选的自瞄准模式将扩散起草与AR校验相结合,并在COCO上提高肽导解码的速度和精度,在Ground Anything-VLM上实现4.51×\时速加速,只有0.74pp F1mIoU下降. 与SGLang,CUDA Graph,以及FP8的系统基础设施实验,通过渐进推论优化,支持在现实世界应用中高效的视觉定位,进一步展示实际速度.

blocks.en: In summary, our major contributions are as follows: • Unlocking diffusion for broad visual grounding. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B foundation model that unifies diverse grounding tasks with precise localization and parallel decoding, trained through grounding pretraining, AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement learning. • State-of-the-art grounding at 4B scale. Across 30 benchmarks, GroundAnything surpasses the prior overall state of the art among similarly sized AR models and outperforms the larger Qwen3.7-Max. GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall state of the art at this scale and remains competitive with GPT-6 Astra. • Systematic acceleration studies. We analyze decoding strategies in detail, compare with MTP-based generation, and evaluate progressive infrastructure optimizations for practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 解锁传播,用于广泛的视觉基础. 我们引入了Ground Anything,一种4B基础模型,它通过定位预训、AR-扩散转换和共同目标、有监督的微调以及基于GRPO的强化学习,将各种定位任务与精确定位和平行解码统一起来。 • 4B级最先进的地面。 在30个基准中,Ground Anything超越了类似体积的AR模型中之前的总体技术水平,并且超过了更大的Qune3.7-Max。 Ground Anything-VLM在这个规模上建立了新的整体技术水平,并且与GPT-6 Astra保持竞争力. • 系统加速研究。 我们详细分析解码战略,与基于中期计划的生成相比较,并评价逐步的基础设施优化,以便实际部署。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉地面

blocks.en: Object detectors such as YOLO establish efficient localization within predefined category vocabularies ( Redmon et al., 2016 ) . Grounded vision–language pretraining extends detection to language-conditioned, open-set localization ( Li et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Generative approaches formulate detection as autoregressive next-token prediction ( Chen et al., 2022 ) and integrate spatial grounding into multimodal language modeling ( Peng et al., 2023 ) . Structured generation unifies diverse perception tasks ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) , while quantized coordinates, large-scale grounding data, and reinforcement post-training strengthen localization ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . However, AR generation serializes spatial predictions, increasing decoding costs for dense outputs. MTP-based parallel box decoding reduces this overhead by treating boxes and points as atomic generation units ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . This progression motivates exploring alternative parallel generation mechanisms for broad and precise grounding.
blocks.zh: YOLO等物体探测器在预定义的类别词汇中建立高效的本地化(Redmon等人,2016年). 基础视觉-语言预训将检测扩展到语言条件化的开放定位(Li等人,2022年;Liu等人,2024年)。 基因方法形成检测结果,作为自动递归的下位预测(Chen等人,2022年),并将空间定位纳入多式联运模式(Peng等人,2023年). 结构化生成统一了多样的感知任务(Xiao等人,2024年),同时量化坐标,大规模地面数据,强化后训练强化本地化(Jiang等人,2026年). 然而,AR生成序列化了空间预测,增加了密集输出的解码成本. 基于MTP的平行箱解码通过将箱和点作为原子生成单位来减少这种间接费用(Wang等人,2026年). 这一进展促使人们探索替代的平行生成机制,以便广泛和准确地确定基础。

blocks.en: 2.2 Diffusion Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 传播视觉语言模式

blocks.en: Masked diffusion offers a complementary route to parallel generation through bidirectional conditioning and iterative token recovery. Diffusion VLMs demonstrate its potential for visual instruction following and multimodal understanding ( You et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Direct AR-to-diffusion conversion adapts pretrained VLMs for efficient blockwise generation ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . Beyond general understanding, specialized applications include GUI grounding with geometry-aware masking ( Kumbhar et al., 2026 ) and structured document OCR with blockwise denoising ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . These studies demonstrate the promise of diffusion in both general multimodal understanding and specialized visual tasks. Nevertheless, a unified diffusion grounding foundation that preserves precise localization across heterogeneous tasks remains underexplored. GroundAnything addresses this gap through grounding-focused training and a shared structured output interface, combining broad perceptual capabilities with efficient parallel decoding.
blocks.zh: 蒙面扩散通过双向调节和迭代代号恢复,为平行生成提供了一条补充路线. 扩散的VLM显示其在视觉教学方面的潜力,遵循和多模式理解(You等人, 2026b;Li等人, 2026b). 直接的AR-向扩散转化使预先训练的VLM适应高效的阻断生成(Wu等人, 2026a). 除了一般理解外,专门应用还包括用几何感知遮盖的图形用户界面定位(Kumbhar等人,2026年)和结构化文件OCR,以阻断(Dong等人,2026年). 这些研究表明,在一般的多式联运理解和专门的视觉任务中都有可能传播。 然而,保持不同任务精确本地化的统一传播基础仍然没有得到充分利用。 地面 任何事情都通过以基础为重点的培训和共享结构化产出接口来解决这一差距,将广泛的认知能力与高效的平行解码相结合。

blocks.en: 2.3 Parallel Decoding
blocks.zh: 2.3 平行解码

blocks.en: Prior work explores blockwise generation ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) , adaptive parallel sampling ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Ben-Hamu et al., 2026 ) , and diffusion-based speculative decoding ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ) . Further work emphasizes practical acceleration through optimized inference infrastructure ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by these advances, we examine decoding choices for GroundAnything in detail, studying their speed–accuracy trade-offs and extending the analysis to comparisons with MTP-based generation and progressive infrastructure optimizations.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作探索了阻断生成(Arriola等人,2025年),适应性平行采样(Wu等人,2026年b;Ben-Hamu等人,2026年),以及基于扩散的投机解码(Liu等人,2026年a;Wu等人,2026年a). 进一步的工作强调通过优化推论基础设施实现实际加速(刘等人,2025年)。 在这些进步的推动下,我们详细研究了Ground Anything的解码选择,研究其速度-准确性权衡,并将分析扩展到与基于中期计划的一代和渐进式基础设施优化的比较。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation: Grounding as Structured Visual Evidence Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题提法:以结构化视觉证据提取为依据

blocks.en: Given an image I I and a task query Q Q , grounding extracts semantic identifiers and their spatial evidence, represented by boxes, points, or ordered point sequences. We serialize this evidence as Y = ( y 1 , … , y L ) Y=(y_{1},\ldots,y_{L}) using a shared vocabulary of text, structural markers, and quantized coordinates ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) ; input/output conventions are detailed in Section 6.1 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 示范建筑

blocks.en:
GroundAnything is a diffusion grounding model obtained by directly converting GroundAnything-VLM, an autoregressive grounding model trained through multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement post-training. It combines a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder ( Team et al., 2026 ) , a projector with 2 × 2 2\times 2 spatial aggregation and a two-layer MLP, and a Qwen3-4B language decoder ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ( Figure 1 ).
Its variable-length output interface uses a shared vocabulary for semantic labels, protocol markers, and 1,000 quantized coordinate tokens ( <0> – <999> ); absent queried categories receive a None payload. The conversion introduces a mask token and jointly trains causal prediction and blockwise denoising with B = 32 B=32 ; both modes share the decoder and vocabulary head, enabling parallel grounding and optional self-speculative decoding ( Section 3.4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
任何地面都是一种传播地面模型,通过直接转换地面-任何VLM获得。 地面-VLM是一种自转地面模型,通过多式联运和空间预训、有监督的微调和强化培训后培训而培训。 它结合了一个月球ViT-V2(Kimi K3)视觉编码器(Team等人,2026年),一个带有2×2 2\times 2空间聚合和两层MLP的投影仪,和一个Quen3-4B语言解码器(Yang等人,2025年)(图1).
其可变长输出界面使用一个通用词汇,用于语义标签、协议标记和1000个量化坐标符(<0> - <999>);没有被询问的类别收到一个无有效载荷。 转换引入一个掩码符,并联合训练因果预测,用B = 32 B = 32 阻断解码;两种模式都共享解码器和词汇头,可以平行地打地基和可选的自我推测解码(第3.4.2节).

blocks.en: 3.3 GroundAnything Data
blocks.zh: 3.3 任何数据

blocks.en: Training data combines public datasets with annotations produced by our data engine.
blocks.zh: 培训数据将公共数据集与我们的数据引擎制作的说明相结合。

blocks.en: Our data engine ( Figure 2 ) fuses multi-teacher annotations at the field level and applies task-specific validation. Accepted labels train a unified grounding expert for iterative annotation; complementary teachers and local observations resolve uncertain cases. This process expands supervision while refining existing labels. Field validity and query-level coverage are checked separately, so an empty result alone does not establish absence. Fusion, validation, and expert iteration are detailed in Section 6.3 .

blocks.en: Base pretraining has three stages. Vision–language connector alignment trains the projector on image–text pairs with both backbones frozen. blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details and Evaluation Setup.
blocks.zh: 4.1 实施细节和评价设置。

blocks.en:
We evaluate GroundAnything-VLM and GroundAnything against 44 baselines on 30 benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, covering specialized detectors, general-purpose VLMs, grounding specialists, and embodied foundations. All numerical results and conclusions involving our models are based on the mean of ten runs, using five random seeds with two runs per seed. Owing to the high computational cost, other baselines that we evaluate locally for the main leaderboard are averaged over three runs, using three random seeds with one run per seed. GPT-6 Astra uses thinking effort High .
We report F1mIoU for box grounding and OCR, F1@Point for object pointing, and task-specific accuracy for spatial and GUI grounding.
blocks.zh:
我们对照44个基线对地面-甚高分辨率和地面-任何东西进行评估,其30个基准涵盖11个认知能力,涵盖专门探测器、通用甚高分辨率和地面专家,并包含各种基础。 涉及我们模型的所有数字结果和结论都以10次运行的平均值为基础,使用5个随机种子,每个种子有2次运行. 由于计算成本高,我们在当地对主标盘进行评价的其他基线平均在3次运行中,使用3个随机种子,每个种子1次运行. GPT-6 Astra使用思维力 高。
我们报告F1mIoU用于箱位定位和OCR,F1@Point用于对象指针,任务特定精确度用于空间和图形界面定位。

blocks.en:
For a fair comparison of diffusion language model (DLM) decoding, all GroundAnything results in the main benchmark tables (Tables 1 – 4 ) use entropy-guided diffusion decoding, without self-speculative decoding.
The self-speculative setting provides higher throughput and quality at the reported operating point, but combines diffusion drafting with causal autoregressive (AR) verification and correction; it is therefore not pure DLM decoding.
We analyze this setting separately in Section 4.3 and highlight it in the teaser (Figure ).

自摸设定在报告的操作点提供了更高的吞吐量和质量,但将扩散起草与因果自递性(AR)校验和校正相结合;因此它并非纯粹的DLM解码.

blocks.en:
Detection covers common and long-tailed objects on COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and LVIS ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) , and dense and tiny objects on Dense200 ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and VisDrone ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) .
Referring grounding uses RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg ( Yu et al., 2016 ; Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) ; object pointing covers the four detection datasets and RefCOCOg.
Spatial and GUI grounding use RoboSpatial ( Song et al., 2025 ) , RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , ScreenSpot-V2 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2026 ) .
OCR uses HierText ( Long et al., 2022 ) , ICDAR2015 ( Karatzas et al., 2015 ) , TotalText ( Ch’Ng & Chan, 2017 ) , and SROIE ( Huang et al., 2019 ) ; layout grounding uses DocLayNet ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ) and M6Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) .
Exemplar-based visual prompting on FSC147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) and Dense200 is also included in the main results.

blocks.en: At K = 16 K=16 , one-step DLM accepts 3.48 draft tokens per round versus 2.69 for causal MTP ( Figure 11 ), yielding more useful proposals at the same candidate length.

blocks.en:
Including drafting, verification, and rejected work, one-step DLM reduces full-round cost per accepted draft token from 7.71 to 5.38 ms ( Figure 11 ).
Higher acceptance therefore translates into lower wall-clock cost at this operating point.
blocks.zh:
包括起草、核查和拒绝的工作,一步DLM将每个接受的草稿的全程费用从7.71毫秒减少到5.38毫秒(图11)。
因此,接受率的提高意味着在这个操作点的墙时费用降低。

blocks.en:
At K = 16 K=16 , a second DLM refinement step lowers this cost to 4.70 ms; further refinement increases it.
With validation-selected policies on the long-output subset, DLM commits 97.1 versus 84.6 tokens within 400 ms, although MTP leads at 50 ms ( Figure 12 ).
Refinement is thus useful when its acceptance gain repays its additional latency.
blocks.zh:
在K = 16 K = 16时,第二个DLM精炼步骤将这一成本降低到4.70毫秒;进一步的精炼会增加.
通过对长期产出子集的审定政策,DLM在400米以内承诺97.1比84.6令牌,尽管中期计划领先50米(图12)。
因此,当其接受收益偿还其额外延迟时,完善是有用的。

blocks.en:
Bidirectional DLM reduces Dense200’s unmatched valid-proposal rate from 24.89% for causal MTP to 14.79%; its retrained causal counterpart scores 21.74% ( Figure 13 ).
This supports bidirectional attention for drafting jointly constrained spatial predictions.
Bidirectional block-MTP also improves draft quality, so the benefit is not exclusive to diffusion.

这有助于双向注意共同起草受限制的空间预测。

blocks.en: Takeaway 1: Grounding as visual evidence extraction naturally suits bidirectional diffusion: related spatial fields share the same image evidence and can be filled jointly, then selectively refined before commitment. This connects the task’s structure to parallel decoding.

blocks.en: Takeaway 2: Diffusion is a generation strategy within a Transformer backbone ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . Its distinctive value lies in suitable workloads, such as parallel filling and structured outputs, where joint prediction and limited refinement can repay their computational cost.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced GroundAnything, reconciling fast parallel decoding with broad and precise visual grounding. Structured grounding naturally suits DLMs: its predictions are jointly constrained by shared visual evidence. Diffusion complements the Transformer backbone through a generation process with distinctive strengths in parallel filling and structured outputs. Causal conditioning supports long outputs across blocks, while diffusion accelerates prediction within them. GroundAnything thus highlights a broader principle: generation should follow task structure, and spatial evidence need not be inferred in the order it is serialized.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了任何地面, 调和快速平行的解码 与广泛和精确的视觉地面。 结构地基自然适合DLM:其预测受到共享视觉证据的共同制约. 扩散通过一代人的过程对变形器骨干进行补充,在平行的填充和结构化产出方面具有显著的优势。 致病条件支持跨区块的长输出,同时扩散加速其中的预测. 地面 因此,任何事情都突出了一个更广泛的原则:生成应当遵循任务结构,空间证据不需要按序列顺序推断。

blocks.en: 6.5 Base VLM Training (Pretrain 1)
blocks.zh: 6.5 基本VLM培训(Pretrain 1)

blocks.en: The vision encoder and language backbone are frozen, and only the projector is trained on image-caption data. Assistant-only causal cross-entropy aligns the visual features with the language input space.
blocks.zh: 视觉编码器和语言骨干被冷冻,只有投影仪接受图像封装数据的培训. 唯助因果交叉通体将视觉特征与语言输入空间相协调.

blocks.en: All modules are unfrozen and jointly trained on pure text and general image–text data. Pure-text examples supervise all valid causal text targets; multimodal examples supervise assistant responses, excluding visual inputs, prompts, and masked template positions. The text and multimodal losses are normalized separately over their valid target tokens and then summed, ℒ mix = ℒ text + ℒ vlm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}} . Counts are aggregated across data-parallel workers so that each domain contributes its global token mean. Packing preserves independent subsequence boundaries and supervision masks.
blocks.zh: 所有模块均解冻,并联合培训纯文本和一般图像文本数据。 纯文本实例监督所有有效的因果文本目标;多式联运实例监督助手的响应,不包括视觉输入,提示和遮蔽模板位置. 文本和多式联运损失在有效目标符号上分别正常化,然后归纳,L mix = L text + L vlm\ mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ mix}}=\matthcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\matathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}。 计算是跨数据平行工作者的汇总,以便每个领域贡献其全球象征值平均值。 包装保留了独立的子序列界限和监督面具.

blocks.en: All modules continue training on general visual question answering and instruction-following data, image captions, and video data with assistant-only causal cross-entropy. The configured context and packing lengths are both 32K. This stage has no separate pure-text quota or dedicated spatial-specialization mixture; spatial supervision is concentrated in Pretrain 2. Aggregate base-pretraining exposure exceeds 700B tokens.

blocks.en: 6.6 Coordinate Alignment (Pretrain 2 / SFT)
blocks.zh: 6.6 坐标对齐(Pretrain 2 / SFT)

blocks.en: Initialized from the Stage 3 checkpoint, coordinate alignment updates the vision encoder, projector, and language parameters on eight spatial task groups: detection, GUI grounding, referring grounding, referring pointing, OCR, document layout, dense pointing and counting, and visual prompting. Boxes, points, semantic identifiers, and protocol markers are supervised jointly as assistant-response tokens. The coordinate tokens <0> through <999> use the same causal cross-entropy objective as the other valid response tokens. This single alignment phase is the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase referred to in the main text. Its context and packing lengths are 8K.
blocks.zh: 从第3阶段检查点初始化,协调对齐更新了8个空间任务组上的视觉编码器,投影仪,语言参数:检测,GUI定位,引用地面,引用指针,OCR,文档布局,密集指针和计数,以及视觉提示. 箱,点,语义识别符,和协议标记作为助理-应答符号共同监督. 坐标符号<0>至<999>使用与其他有效响应符号相同的因果交叉切入目标. 这个单一的对齐阶段是正文中提到的有监督的微调(SFT)阶段. 其上下文和包装长度为8K.

blocks.en: 6.8 Reinforcement Learning (RL): Causal GRPO

blocks.en: RL is the final training phase for both variants, following coordinate alignment for GroundAnything-VLM and AR-to-Diffusion conversion for GroundAnything. GroundAnything uses causal attention for both rollout generation and likelihood evaluation. For each prompt, G = 8 G=8 responses are sampled at temperature T = 0.7 T=0.7 . Before updating, a no-gradient teacher-forcing pass records detached old-policy log-probabilities; a second pass computes current-policy gradients. Both use FP32 log-softmax at the rollout temperature. These are exact likelihoods of the causal policy, not likelihoods of a diffusion denoising trajectory.
blocks.zh: RL是两种变体的最后培训阶段,在协调GroundAnything-VLM和AR-对扩散转换用于GroundAnything之后。 地面 任何事情都使用因果注意来产生和进行可能性评价。 对于每个速率,在温度T=0.7 T=0.7时对G=8 G=8的响应进行抽样. 在更新之前,一个不升级的教师强制通过记录可以剥离旧政策日志概率;第二个通过计算当前政策梯度. 两者在推出温度时均使用FP32log-softmax. 这些是因果政策的确切可能性,而不是扩散去名化轨迹的可能性。

Thus, a block requiring D D denoising passes uses D + 1 D+1 NFEs, excluding initial prefill. The number of passes depends on commitment decisions rather than a fixed per-response denoising count.

blocks.en: Dynamic Decoding uses a confidence threshold with a forced best-position fallback. Static Decoding commits the highest-confidence remaining positions under a prescribed per-pass quota, distributing the remaining positions across the remaining passes. These policies change token commitment, while preserving blockwise generation. They are distinct from AR verification; their confidence scores should not be identified with the unmodified-logit entropy used above.

blocks.en: Each drafter receives the same diagnostic windows: category transitions from COCO, crowded objects from Dense200, document regions from DocLayNet, and GUI targets from ScreenSpot-Pro. Candidate length is matched, both DLM variants use two refinement steps, and the bidirectional block-MTP control uses one pass. Diagnostic windows are selected from the common reference serialization before inspecting proposals. Raw format error detects illegal structural transitions, token types, or coordinate arity, using the parser state inherited from the prefix. Ending partway through an otherwise valid tuple at the candidate boundary is not itself a format error. Diagnostics precede grammar filtering, fallback, and verification.

blocks.en:
Relative to causal MTP, bidirectional DLM reduces COCO format errors from 5.01% to 1.80%.
Its valid-box miss rate decreases by 10.10 pp on Dense200 and 7.52 pp on DocLayNet, compared with only 0.46 pp on GUI.
These differences are consistent with greater benefits for proposals containing several spatially related elements.
The retrained DLM pair provides the attention control: bidirectional attention lowers the Dense200 rate from 21.74% to 14.79% at the same refinement depth.
Bidirectional block-MTP also improves over causal MTP, so bidirectionality itself is not a uniquely diffusion-based advantage.
Its one-pass comparison with two-step DLM changes objective and refinement cost; it does not isolate diffusion training at equal elapsed time.
The separate deadline analysis provides the matched-time comparison.

相对于因果MTP,双向DLM将COCO格式错误从5.01%降至1.80%.
其有效框误差率在Dense200上减少了10.10页,在DocLayNet上减少了7.52页,而GUI上只有0.46页.
这些差异与包含若干空间相关要素的提案的更大好处是一致的。
重新训练的DLM配对提供了注意控制:双向注意使同精度深度的Dense200率从21.74%降低到14.79%.
双向块-MTP也比因果MTP有所改进,因此双向本身不是一个独特的扩散优势.
它与两步骤的DLM的单程比较改变了目标和精细化成本;它不会在相同时间隔离传播培训。
单独的截止日期分析提供了相应的时间比较。

blocks.en:
Together, the acceptance, cost, and deadline results support Finding 2.2 : bidirectional diffusion with limited refinement makes draft generation more efficient than the tested causal MTP baseline over the reported operating range.
The attention control supports joint access to visual evidence, while the refinement sweep identifies when an additional denoising pass repays its cost; neither establishes superiority over every MTP design.
The geometric diagnostic measures proposal reliability before verification, separately from ScreenSpot accuracy, F1mIoU, and ground-truth recall.
Exact verification preserves the shared causal model’s completed output.

接受率、成本和最后期限结果共同支持了结果2.2:双向传播,改进有限,使草案生成效率高于所报告操作范围内经过测试的因果中期计划基线。
注意力控制支持联合获取视觉证据,而精细扫描则识别出额外解密通行证偿还其成本的时间;两者都不确定优于每个中期计划设计.
几何诊断测量方法在核查前提出了可靠性建议,与ScreenSpot准确性、F1mIoU和地面真实性召回不同。
精确的核查保留了共享因果模型完成的产出.

blocks.en:
TPF denotes committed output tokens per model forward; TPS denotes output tokens per second.
Forward counts must include the causal cache-construction or verification passes required by the relevant schedule.
The physical block size B B in the decoding sweeps includes the known anchor, whereas candidate length K K in the DLM–MTP comparison counts newly proposed tokens.
The two quantities should not be identified.
All quality values in the decoding sweeps are COCO F1mIoU, and their speed–accuracy trade-offs should not be extrapolated to a 30-benchmark quality average.

The AR reference is 49.6 TPS with 63.70 F1mIoU.
At B = 32 B=32 , throughput is 223.8 TPS for linear self-speculation, 49.9 TPS for quadratic self-speculation, and 127.0 TPS for entropy guidance at τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 .
The corresponding COCO quality is 62.96 for linear self-speculation and 60.72 for entropy guidance.
Thus, the two main speedups are 223.8 / 49.6 = 4.51 × 223.8/49.6=4.51\times and 127.0 / 49.6 = 2.56 × 127.0/49.6=2.56\times , with quality gaps of 0.74 and 2.98 pp.

blocks.en:
Linear TPF rises from 1.41 at B = 4 B=4 to 2.21 at B = 16 B=16 , then changes little at B = 32 B=32 (2.18).
Quadratic TPF reaches 3.17 at both B = 16 B=16 and B = 32 B=32 .
At B = 32 B=32 , its 45.4% higher TPF nevertheless accompanies much lower TPS than the linear schedule.
Fusing verification and proposal reduces forward-call count but increases the number of query tokens, illustrating why TPF alone is not a latency metric.
From B = 16 B=16 to B = 32 B=32 , linear throughput changes from 226.6 to 223.8 TPS, whereas quadratic throughput falls from 88.0 to 49.9 TPS.

blocks.en:
As τ \tau increases from 0.2 to 1.2, TPF increases from 1.02 to 1.60 and TPS from 107.3 to 148.7.
COCO F1mIoU remains near 60 for τ ≤ 0.8 \tau\leq 0.8 , peaks at 60.72 at τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 , falls to 54.06 at τ = 1.0 \tau=1.0 , and partly recovers to 56.14 at τ = 1.2 \tau=1.2 .
The non-monotonic quality curve supports a speed–accuracy trade-off rather than a universal monotonic accuracy law.
Increasing τ \tau permits more uncertain tokens to be committed together; the observed quality drop is consistent with the risk of premature commitment.

blocks.en:
Entropy-guided TPF changes only from 1.18 to 1.24 over the tested block sizes, while its best COCO score is 61.58 at B = 16 B=16 .
Linear self-speculation attains its best tested COCO score at B = 32 B=32 .
Consequently, the B = 32 B=32 operating point used for the headline comparison is not the maximum-quality choice for every decoding strategy.
Block-size selection therefore depends on task quality and output length; the COCO sweep alone does not establish a universal optimum.

blocks.en:
Self-speculation verifies against the converted model’s causal branch.
Exact greedy verification preserves that branch’s outputs, not necessarily the outputs of the separately trained GroundAnything-VLM.
The 0.74 pp gap to GroundAnything-VLM therefore does not imply that the verifier accepts mismatching tokens.
Direct entropy-guided decoding has no AR acceptance test and remains the appropriate main-table setting for assessing diffusion generation itself.

Coordinate loss across adaptation budgets and dense/tiny-object localization would test this hypothesis; entropy-based commitment and final box metrics require separate evaluation beyond the fixed-context analysis.

Its SEED1.5-VL row is taken from that work.
The GroundAnything variants use the same structured vocabulary and have identical reported output statistics: 7.6 tokens/box on COCO and 5.1 on Dense200.
Compared with 148.8 and 74.5 tokens/box for SEED1.5-VL, these are approximately 19.6 × 19.6\times and 14.6 × 14.6\times lower token counts per box.
The ratios reflect serialization length, not matched-hardware latency; differences in detected instance counts and model execution preclude reading them as speedups.

blocks.en:
The suite covers common and long-tailed detection on COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and LVIS ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) ; dense and tiny-object detection on Dense200 ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and VisDrone ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) ; referring grounding on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg ( Yu et al., 2016 ; Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) ; and object pointing on COCO, LVIS, Dense200, VisDrone, and RefCOCOg val/test.
Spatial pointing uses RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and RoboSpatial ( Song et al., 2025 ) , while GUI grounding uses ScreenSpot-V2 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2026 ) .
OCR covers HierText ( Long et al., 2022 ) , ICDAR2015 ( Karatzas et al., 2015 ) , TotalText ( Ch’Ng & Chan, 2017 ) , and SROIE ( Huang et al., 2019 ) ; layout grounding uses DocLayNet ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ) and M6Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) ; visual prompting uses FSC147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) and Dense200.

blocks.en:
Following the grounding evaluation convention of Jiang et al. (2026) , box tasks report recall, precision, and F1 at IoU 0.50 and 0.95, together with their reported aggregates over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95.
F1mIoU denotes the threshold-aggregated F1 score, not mean matched-box IoU.
OCR additionally requires transcription agreement under the loose-match evaluation protocol and reports parse-error rates separately.
Object pointing uses point-in-mask F1; spatial pointing uses point-in-mask accuracy, ScreenSpot uses action accuracy, and OSWorld-G uses exact accuracy.
RefCOCO avg is the unweighted mean of the three family entries; RefSpatial avg averages Location and Placement.
Reported benchmark entries are preserved, and missing metrics are not reconstructed from other scores.
blocks.zh:
江等人(2026年)的基数评价公约之后,箱式任务报告召回,精度,以及IoU 0.50和0.95的F1,以及它们报告的超过IoU阈值的总量从0.50到0.95.
F1mIoU表示阈值汇总的F1分数,而非表示匹配的框IoU.
OCR还要求根据不匹配的评价协议签订抄录协议,并分别报告解析率。
对象指点使用点入面具F1;空间指点使用点入面具精度,ScreenSpot使用动作精度,OSWorld-G使用精确精度.
RefCOCO avg是三个家庭条目的未加权平均值;RefSpatial avg平均位置和安置。
报告的基准条目被保留,缺失的度量衡不会从其他分数中重建.

blocks.en:

The relevant captions specify their sources. In particular, selected detector, SEED1.5-VL, Molmo, spatial, and GUI references are taken from Jiang et al. (2026) ; GUI-Owl references follow Wang et al. (2026) .
Size groups refer to language-backbone configurations; the 7B understanding branch is used for MoT models and total language parameters for MoE models. Qwen3.7-Max, Kimi-K2.6, Kimi-K3, and GPT-6 Astra are grouped separately in the > 1 >1 T category.

blocks.en: 10.10 Potential Application Scenarios
blocks.zh: 10.10 潜在应用设想

blocks.en: The following prospective workflows combine changing queries with substantial spatial output; they are opportunities for evaluation rather than demonstrated deployments.
blocks.zh: 以下工作流程将不断变化的查询与大量空间产出结合起来;它们是评价的机会,而不是展示的部署。

blocks.en:
Language or exemplar queries can specify defects, components, assembly checks, and labels across changing product lines.
Parallel output is particularly relevant when each image requires many localized results.
blocks.zh:
语言或示例查询可以指定缺陷,组件,组装检查,以及跨越不断变化的产品线的标签.
当每个图像都需要许多本地化结果时,平行产出特别相关。

blocks.en:
Batch processing of robot views, manipulation keyframes, and road images can produce candidate object, part, text, and relation-conditioned spatial annotations.
Lower decoding cost could expand annotation and review capacity as images, queries, and instances multiply.
blocks.zh:
批次处理机器人视图,操纵键框,路面图像可以生成候选对象,部分,文本,以及关系条件空间说明.
随着图像、查询和实例的倍增,较低的解码费用可以扩大注释和审查能力。

blocks.en:
Image tiles of ports, car parks, airports, and urban areas require locating many queried instances.
Open queries and long coordinate lists make this a useful setting for evaluating parallel spatial extraction.
blocks.zh:
港口、停车场、机场和城市地区的图砖需要找到许多被询问的例子。
开放的查询和长坐标列表使得它成为评价平行空间提取的有益环境.

blocks.en:
Receipts, forms, archives, and complex pages require text together with region locations.
Long transcriptions and multi-region outputs make this a practical test of decoding savings at matched extraction quality.
blocks.zh:
收据、表格、档案和复杂网页需要文本与区域位置。
长的文字记录和多区域产出使这项试验成为以相应的提取质量对节省进行解码的一个实际考验。

blocks.en:
Candidate boxes or points for cells, nuclei, and repeated structures could assist research counting and expert review.
Domain-specific reliability requires separate evaluation before using these annotations in specialist workflows.
blocks.zh:
细胞、核和重复结构的候选框或点数可有助于研究计数和专家审查。
特定领域的可靠性要求在专家工作流程中使用这些说明之前进行单独评价。

blocks.en:
Sampled frames can be queried for players, balls, officials, and jersey numbers, including appearance or spatial conditions.
Cheaper frame-level extraction could support denser sampling; temporal association remains a downstream task.
blocks.zh:
样本框可以询问玩家,球,官员,以及球衣号码,包括外观或空间条件.
较便宜的帧级采掘可以支持更密集的采样;时间关联仍然是下游的任务.

blocks.en:
Crowded shelves, logistics bins, orchards, and nurseries combine repeated instances with changing appearance or region queries.
Exemplar conditioning provides a useful interface when category names alone are insufficient.
blocks.zh:
拥挤的货架、物流箱、果园和托儿所将反复出现的情况与不断变化的外观或区域查询结合起来。
当单独分类名称不足时,实例配置提供了一个有用的界面.

blocks.en:
Users can revise descriptions and confirm candidate boxes, points, or click locations through repeated queries.
Short responses should be assessed by end-to-end interaction latency, including visual processing and prefill.
blocks.zh:
用户可以通过反复查询修改描述并确认候选框,点,或点击位置.
简短的响应应当通过端到端的交互延时来评估,包括视觉处理和预填.

blocks.en: 10.11.1 General Object Grounding
blocks.zh: 10.11.1 (中文(简体) ). 常规对象定位

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Multi-scale object grounding in a cluttered indoor scene.
blocks.zh: 图17:多尺度物体在密布的室内场景中搁浅.

blocks.en: The indoor scene in Figure 17 combines people, furniture, books, containers, and small accessories. Large objects provide scene context, while partially visible items and accessories require finer spatial discrimination. The displayed annotations illustrate the need to retain instance identity across scale and occlusion, rather than replacing a collection of nearby objects with one broad region. In particular, distinguishing an accessory from its wearer requires semantic association as well as localization. The supplied Ours panel is explicitly marked as a GT-completed display and is treated as an illustrative rendering, not as an unedited prediction set.
blocks.zh: 图17中的室内场景结合了人,家具,书籍,容器和小配件. 大型物体提供场景背景,而部分可见的物品和附件则需要更细的空间区分. 所显示的说明说明需要在整个尺度和封存范围内保留实例特征,而不是用一个广阔的区域来取代附近的一批物体。 特别是,区分从属物和佩戴者需要语义联系以及本地化。 所供应的Ours面板被明确标记为GT完成的显示,被作为说明性渲染,而不是未经编辑的预测集.

blocks.en: 10.11.2 Dense Object Grounding
blocks.zh: 10.11.2 国家 强烈对象定位

blocks.en: Figure 18 : Dense instance grounding of fruit decorations.
blocks.zh: 图18:水果装饰的露天展示。

blocks.en: The repeated fruit decorations in Figure 18 vary in apparent size and overlap along a central support and surrounding garlands. The comparison illustrates a distinction between localizing individual fruits and enclosing an entire decorated structure. Several broad boxes in the comparison panels merge multiple instances, whereas the displayed Ours panel retains finer instance granularity. Adjacent fruits with similar color make both duplicate suppression and boundary separation difficult. The curated visualization illustrates these error modes without assigning additional detection scores.
blocks.zh: 图18中重复的水果装饰在明显大小上有所不同,沿中央支撑和周围的花纹重叠. 比较表明,将个别水果本地化与包含整个装饰结构之间有区别。 比较面板中的几个宽框合并了多个实例,而显示的 Ours 面板保留了更细的实例颗粒性。 相邻的类似颜色的水果使得重复压制和边界分离都变得困难. 整理的可视化显示这些错误模式,而不分配额外的检测分数.

blocks.en: Figure 19 : Dense grounding of repeated bricks.
blocks.zh: 图19:重复砖块的坚硬地面。

blocks.en: Figure 19 uses a brick wall to probe repeated structures with small appearance differences. The displayed Ours boxes follow individual bricks and preserve the staggered rows, whereas crossing or oversized boxes in the comparison panels mix neighboring units. Success here requires aligning the queried unit with local mortar boundaries while maintaining consistency across a large set of nearly interchangeable instances. The figure is a qualitative illustration of spatial granularity; an unannotated comparison panel alone does not identify the underlying cause of a missing display.
blocks.zh: 图19使用砖墙探测外观差异小的重复结构. 显示的 Ours 框跟随单个砖块并保存交错的行,而比较面板中的横跨或超大小的框则混合邻单元. 这方面的成功需要使被询问的单位与当地迫击炮的边界保持一致,同时在一系列几乎可以互换的事例中保持一致性。 该图是对空间颗粒性的一个定性说明;单是无说明的比较面板并不能确定缺失显示的根本原因.

blocks.en: 10.11.3 Referring Grounding and Complex Visual Configurations
blocks.zh: 10.11.3 国家 参考地面和复杂视觉配置

blocks.en: Figure 20 : Separating overlapping birds with deceptive silhouettes.
blocks.zh: 图20:将重叠的鸟类与欺骗性的硅胶分离。

blocks.en: Figure 20 presents a visually deceptive configuration: two birds overlap so closely that their similar feather textures and aligned body contours can resemble a single two-headed bird. A third bird is only partly visible at the lower image boundary. The Rex-Omni panel encloses the overlapping pair in one large box and marks the foreground bird separately; LocateAnything shows one broad box; the Ours panel distinguishes the two overlapping instances and the truncated foreground instance. The relevant evidence includes two distinct heads and beaks, differently oriented necks, and the relationship between each head and its body contour. A purely salient-region interpretation can merge those cues into one object. Resolving the ambiguity calls for instance-level semantic understanding, occlusion reasoning, and spatial part association, motivating a strong vision–language foundation rather than localization based on isolated texture or outline alone. This example illustrates a demanding capability; a single selected case does not establish a particular internal reasoning mechanism or a universal advantage over all competing models.
blocks.zh: 图20显示了一种视觉欺骗的构型:两只鸟的羽毛纹理和对齐的躯体轮廓重叠得如此密切,可以像一只单双头鸟. 第三只鸟只在较低的图像边界部分可见. Rex-Omni面板将重叠的一对放在一个大盒子内,并分别标记前方鸟类; Lace anything 显示一个宽的框; Ours面板区分两个重叠实例和截断的前方实例. 相关证据包括两个不同的头和喙,不同方向的颈部,以及每个头部与其身体轮廓的关系. 纯粹的突出区域解释可以把这些提示合并为一个目标。 解决这一模糊性需要诸如层次语义理解、隔离推理和空间部分结合,激发强大的视觉-语言基础,而不是仅仅基于孤立的纹理或轮廓的本地化。 这个例子说明了一种要求很高的能力;一个单一的选定案例没有建立一个特定的内部推理机制,或者对所有竞争模式都具有普遍优势。

blocks.en: Figure 21 : Grounding a pair specified by a visual relationship.
blocks.zh: 图21:设定一对由视觉关系指定的对.

blocks.en: The query in Figure 21 asks for two people who can make eye contact. The relevant pair occupies a small area near the bottom of a poster dominated by much larger portraits. The displayed Ours regions select that pair, while other panels emphasize the larger faces. The challenge is to interpret a relation between two instances and their orientation, rather than rank people by size or salience. This example concerns the visible relational configuration, not an inference about the depicted people’s identity or mental state.
blocks.zh: 图21中的查询要求有两个人可以进行眼睛接触. 相关的一对占据了靠近海报底部的一小块区域,以更大的肖像画为主. 显示的 Ours 区域选择这对, 而其他的面板则强调更大的面孔. 挑战在于解释两种情况之间的关系及其取向,而不是按大小或突出程度对人进行排序。 这个例子涉及明显的关系配置,而不是对描绘的人的身份或精神状态的推论.

blocks.en: Figure 22 : Grounding a spatially specified, partially visible person.
blocks.zh: 图22:定位一个空间指定,部分可见的人.

blocks.en: In Figure 22 , the phrase “the person on the far right” refers to a partially truncated spectator at the image boundary, rather than the prominent foreground participant. The scene contains many people with similar hats and clothing, making category recognition alone insufficient. The displayed Ours box follows the boundary instance. The example illustrates the need to resolve a relative spatial expression over all visible candidates, including small and partly occluded instances, before predicting the target extent.
blocks.zh: 在图22中,“极右侧的人”一语是指图像边界上部分截断的旁观者,而不是突出的前缘参与者。 该场景包含许多戴着类似帽子和服装的人,使得单是类别识别是不够的. 显示的 Ours 框遵循边界实例 。 这个例子表明,在预测目标范围之前,必须解决所有可见候选人的相对空间表达,包括小的和部分没有出现的情况。

blocks.en: 10.11.4 Referring Point-in-Mask Grounding
blocks.zh: 10.11.4 国家 任务定位

blocks.en: Figure 23 : Point grounding within an occluded person’s visible mask.
blocks.zh: 图23:在隐形人的明显面具内扎地。

blocks.en: Figure 23 separates semantic target selection from the geometric requirement that a point lie inside the target’s visible mask. The child is partially hidden by a float, so the enclosing box center can fall on an occluder. The displayed Ours point lies on the visible face, while the comparison points fall on the float or another person. A valid point therefore requires both identifying the intended instance and selecting visible evidence belonging to it, rather than using a generic scene center or box-center heuristic.
blocks.zh: 图23将语义目标选择与几何要求区分开来,即一个点位于目标可见的面具内. 小孩部分被浮体隐藏,因此附着的盒子中心可以掉在占卜器上. 显示的 Ours 点位于可见的面部,而比较点则落在浮点或其他人身上. 因此,一个有效的点要求既要确定预定实例,也要选择属于其的可见证据,而不是使用通用场景中心或箱中心热力。

blocks.en: 10.11.5 Dense Point Grounding
Figure 24 : Dense point grounding of overlapping balloons.
blocks.zh: 图24:重合气球的强度点落地.

blocks.en: Figure 24 contains many balloons with repeated colors, touching outlines, partial occlusions, and instances cut by the image boundary. The displayed points span the arch rather than collapsing the group to a few salient locations. The task combines set coverage with one-point-per-instance consistency: missing small balloons and placing repeated points on the same balloon are distinct errors. Marker size is part of the visualization and should not be interpreted as localization uncertainty or predicted object size.
blocks.zh: 图24包含许多气球,带有重复的颜色,触摸的轮廓,部分隐蔽,以及被图像边界剪切的例. 显示的点横跨拱门,而不是将一组倒塌到几个突出位置。 任务将设定的覆盖与每英寸一分的一致性结合起来:缺失的小气球和在同一气球上反复放置点是明显的错误. 标记大小是可视化的一部分,不应解释为本地化不确定性或预测对象大小.

blocks.en: 10.11.6 Dense Point-in-Mask Grounding
blocks.zh: 10.11.6 (中文(简体) ). 任务定位

blocks.en: Figure 25 : Dense point grounding of vehicles in a night scene.
blocks.zh: 图25:夜幕中车辆的密集点着陆.

blocks.en: Figure 25 shows vehicles from above under low illumination, including moving vehicles on the road and a compact parked group. Ground-truth masks identify the visible vehicle regions, while point predictions must remain within those regions despite shadows and bright headlights. The displayed Ours points cover both isolated and clustered vehicles. The example illustrates why coverage and interior-point placement must be evaluated together: a point on a light streak or adjacent road surface can be close to a vehicle while missing its visible mask.
blocks.zh: 图25显示低照度下的上述车辆,包括路上的移动车辆和一组停靠的紧凑车辆。 地面真面罩可以识别可见的车辆区域,而点预测必须留在这些区域,尽管有阴影和明亮的灯光。 显示的 Ours 点既包括孤立车辆,也包括集群车辆。 这个例子说明为什么必须同时评价覆盖范围和内设点:光线或相邻道路表面的点可以靠近车辆,同时缺少其可见的面具。

blocks.en: 10.11.7 GUI Grounding
blocks.zh: 10.11.7 图形用户界面 设地

blocks.en: Figure 26 : GUI target grounding in a multi-window desktop.
blocks.zh: 图26:GUI目标在多窗口桌面下架.

blocks.en: The desktop in Figure 26 contains an editor, a terminal, a plot window, and a property inspector. The marked reference region is the small plot-title area, surrounded by nearby menu and toolbar controls. The displayed Ours point lies in that region, whereas the comparison points are displaced toward neighboring controls. This case requires assigning a target to the correct window and interpreting local interface structure. It illustrates visual target grounding, not successful execution of an unshown action sequence.
blocks.zh: 图26中的桌面包含一个编辑器,一个终端,一个图案窗口,以及一个财产检查员. 标注的参考区是小地块标题区,周围是附近的菜单和工具栏控件. 我们所展示的点位于那个地区,而比较点则被转移到邻近的控制。 这个案例需要指定一个目标到正确的窗口并解释本地界面结构. 它说明视觉目标搁浅,没有成功执行未显示的行动序列.

blocks.en: 10.11.8 OCR and Artistic Text Understanding
blocks.zh: 10.11.8 OCR和艺术文本理解

blocks.en: Figure 27 : OCR of artistic lettering embedded in illustration.
blocks.zh: 图27:插图中嵌入艺术字母的OCR.

blocks.en: The word “DRAW” in Figure 27 is distributed across staggered, tilted letters embedded in brush strokes and dense line art. Decorative contours resemble character strokes, while the letters do not share a conventional horizontal baseline. The Ours panel reads the two spatial groups as “DR” and “AW”; LocateAnything shows “DR” and “AN”, and Rex-Omni uses a single “DRAW” region. This distinction matters: a complete word box and two correct fragments can both be reasonable annotation granularities, so the split alone is not evidence of superior recognition. The informative feature is maintaining the correct letter identity and its spatial support despite stylization, especially the final W. Such reading requires integrating local strokes with word-level context and distinguishing typography from illustration. It motivates strong visual–linguistic representations while also showing why OCR comparisons must specify both transcription and grouping conventions.
blocks.zh: 图27中的“DRAW”一词分布在插在笔划和密线艺术中的交错、倾斜的字母之间。 装饰轮廓类似字符中风,而字母则不具有常规水平基线. 我们的小组将这两个空间组理解为“DR”和“AW”;Lace anything显示“DR”和“AN”,Rex-Omni使用一个单一的“DRAW”区域。 这种区分关系重大:一个完整的词框和两个正确的片段都可以是合理的注释颗粒,因此单分并不是上级承认的证据. 信息性特征是保持正确的字母身份及其空间支持,尽管存在阶梯化,尤其是最终的W. 此类读取需要将局部中风与词层上下文相结合,并区分打字法与插图. 它激发了强烈的视觉-语言表达,同时也表明为什么OCR比较必须同时说明抄录和分组公约。

blocks.en: Figure 28 : OCR of highly stylized poster lettering.
blocks.zh: 图28:高度结构化海报字母的OCR。

blocks.en: In Figure 28 , the poster combines small conventional words with the oversized, heavily deformed word “FAN” and an illustrated electric fan. Rounded, interlocking glyphs and decorative stars blur the boundary between text and drawing. The Ours panel preserves the large “FAN” region while also identifying smaller words such as “BE”, “YOUR”, and “OWN”. Reading the slogan requires tracking character order across sizes and styles rather than treating all blue shapes as one object. The fan illustration supplies useful semantic context, but a grounded transcription must still be supported by visible letter strokes. This is a demanding vision–language reading example; it does not imply that contextual plausibility can substitute for character evidence or that every small printed line is recovered perfectly.
blocks.zh: 在图28中,海报将小的常规词与体积过大、严重变形的“FAN”词和插图电扇结合在一起。 圆形,相互交错的格子和装饰性恒星模糊了文字和绘图之间的界限. 我们的小组保留了较大的“FAN”区域,同时也确定了“BE”、“YOUR”和“OWN”等较小的词。 阅读标语需要跨大小和风格跟踪字符顺序,而不是将所有蓝色形状当作一个对象. 风扇插图提供了有用的语义上下文,但是一个被禁的抄写仍然必须辅以明显的字母中风. 这是一个要求很高的视觉-语言阅读例子;它并不意味着背景的可信度可以取代性格证据,或者每一个小的印刷线都被完美地回收。

blocks.en: Figure 29 : OCR of outdoor signs with perspective distortion.
blocks.zh: 图29:室外标志的OCR,视线扭曲。

blocks.en: Figure 29 includes large lettering along a curved entrance, a hanging business sign, and smaller roadside text. Perspective changes character orientation and spacing, while foliage and uneven contrast complicate localization. The displayed Ours regions retain separate text groups across these scales; comparison panels illustrate merged phrases and transcription changes. The case highlights joint text–geometry consistency: a plausible phrase in a region that spans multiple signs is different from a transcription aligned to the intended word or line.
blocks.zh: 图29包括沿弯曲的入口处大写字母、悬挂的商务标志和较小的路边文字。 视角会改变人物取向和间距,而叶片和不均匀的对比使本地化复杂化. 显示的“我们的区域”在这些比例表上保留单独的文本组;比较面板说明合并的短语和抄录更改。 案件突出了联合文本-几何一致性:在一个跨多个标志的区域,一个可信的短语不同于与预定的字词或行相一致的抄写。

blocks.en: Figure 30 : OCR of a low-contrast receipt with aligned fields.
blocks.zh: 图30:有对齐字段的低连续收件机。

blocks.en: Figure 31 : Exemplar-guided grounding of repeated rounded objects.
blocks.zh: 图31:重复四舍五入物体的模范制导地面。

blocks.en: Figure 32 : Exemplar-guided grounding of traffic cones.
blocks.zh: 图32:交通锥的模范制导地面。

blocks.en: The faded receipt in Figure 30 contains headings, item descriptions, quantities, unit prices, totals, and tax fields. The displayed Ours regions preserve separate text cells and repeated numerical entries across the document, while comparison panels illustrate merged headers and missed or fragmented lines. Useful OCR must retain both character identity and the layout that associates each value with its row and column. The visualization concerns recognition and localization; it does not establish arithmetic verification or downstream financial correctness.
blocks.zh: 图30中已淡化的收据包括标题、项目说明、数量、单价、总额和税项。 显示的 Ours 区域在整个文档中保留单独的文本单元格和重复的数字条目,而比较面板则显示合并标题和遗漏或零碎的行。 有用的OCR必须既保留字符身份,又保留将每个值与其行和列相联系的布局. 可视化涉及识别和本地化;它没有建立算术验证或下游财务正确性.

blocks.zh: \ WF @ box (帮助)

blocks.en: 10.11.9 Visual-Prompt Grounding
blocks.zh: 第10.11.9条 视觉快速定位

blocks.en: In Figure 31 , a boxed visual exemplar specifies the repeated rounded objects without relying on a category name. The target instances form dense rows with mild shape and size variation. The displayed Ours boxes cover instances across the tray, while the Rex-Omni panel contains sparse and repeated edge-aligned proposals. The LocateAnything panel is explicitly marked N/A and is not treated as a scored failure. The example illustrates transferring an exemplar’s visual identity to many instances while avoiding duplicate localization.
blocks.zh: 在图31中,一个框式的视觉实例指定了重复的四舍五入对象,而不依赖于一个类别名称. 目标实例形成密集的行,形状和大小变化不大。 显示的 Ours 盒子覆盖整个托盘上的一些实例,而Rex-Omni 面板则包含着稀疏且反复的边缘相通的提议. Lace anything 面板被明确标记为非/A,不作为得分失败处理. 这个例子说明了将一个实例的视觉特性转移给许多情况,同时避免重复本地化。

blocks.en: Figure 32 uses a local visual reference to specify cones distributed around a running course. Their apparent size changes strongly with depth, and the scene includes both orange and blue cones. The displayed Ours boxes follow instances from the foreground toward the distant gate, illustrating visual category transfer beyond the exact reference crop. The comparison highlights partial coverage and repeated localization. The panel marked N/A denotes an unavailable comparison, not an observed zero score.
blocks.zh: 图32使用当地视觉参考来指定环绕运行中课程的圆锥. 它们表面的大小随深度变化很大,场景包括橙色和蓝锥. 显示的 Ours 盒子跟随从前方到远端门的事例, 说明视觉类的转移超出了精确的参考作物。 比较突出部分覆盖和反复本地化. 标记为N/A的面板表示无法进行比较,而不是观测到的零分.
